slides.headline: YOU PAY $5,000 A MONTH. AI DOES THAT JOB FOR $20.
slides.image_prompt: Hands mid-ripping $3,000 invoice in half, phone blazes green with AI chat icon, signal red torn paper against lime glow. Amber desk, clean and vivid. Documentary 35mm grain, plain background.

slides.headline: 1) CUT YOUR BIGGEST COST TONIGHT
slides.body: A VA, bookkeeper, or social media manager costs $2,000, $5,000 a month. Claude Pro costs $20.

slides.headline: 2) TRAIN AI ON YOUR BUSINESS BEFORE COMPETITORS DO
slides.body: Upload your SOPs and client documents. Ask Claude: 'I run [business]. Here is my brand guide: [paste]. Write proposals in this exact voice.' In 10 minutes, you have an AI that knows your business.

slides.headline: 3) BUILD ONE INCOME STREAM THAT RUNS WITHOUT YOU
slides.body: A consultant selling $2,000/month content packages, with Claude writing the posts. Ask Claude: 'I deliver [service]. Design a system that delivers this without my direct time each week.' Price it and sell it.

slides.headline: $30 TRILLION. EVERY YEAR.
slides.body: That's Elon's number from the G20 today. Not spread over years. Not the total ever. Per year. The businesses building AI workflows right now are the ones positioned to claim their share of it

slides.headline: 4) OUTRESEARCH EVERY COMPETITOR IN AN HOUR
slides.body: A professional competitive analysis costs $10,000 to $20,000. Ask Claude: 'What customer complaint is everyone in my market ignoring?' You get a strategy your competitors paid tens of thousands to produce.

slides.headline: 5) LOCK IN CHEAP AI BEFORE PRICES RISE
slides.body: Elon flagged a 15-gigawatt power shortfall at the G20. As more businesses compete for computing capacity, AI costs rise. A workflow you build tonight pays today's rates for years.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: THE 2027 WINDOW PLAN
slides.body: VA costs $5,000/month. Claude costs $20. Start tonight. Free competitor intel that firms charge $10,000 for. 15-gigawatt shortfall means AI rates won't stay low. DM 'AI', we'll show which move to make first.

caption:
